title: Speed up the manual cold custody audit: read its full snapshot with one Git process, never in ordinary sync
outcome: Speed up the manual cold custody audit: read its full snapshot with one Git process, never in ordinary sync
acceptance: The cold custody audit's full task snapshot (read_task_snapshot through Reader::cold) reads all task documents with one Git process, using the existing batched reader, instead of one `git cat-file blob` process per document; the number of Git processes the audit starts does not grow with the number of tasks
The audit stays a manual command only (`engram task-sync custody-audit`); a behaviour test or code-path check shows that ordinary sync, export, import and the delta exchange never call it

`task_sync::git::delta::tests::snapshot::complete_cold_snapshot_reads_two_thousand_documents_and_keeps_unverified_envelope` passes on Central under the same load as test-0018b7a5; the test is not loosened
